Priya K.: Quick ask — can someone run a lightweight profiling sweep for tempest-7b (model_id: tempest-7b-v1) on a single A100-80G (fp16) and also an int8 pass if it's cheap? Want p50/p95/p99, peak GPU memory, and tokens/sec for seq_len=1024. Run two modes: streaming (kv-cache active) and non-streaming. Concurrency points: 1, 8, 32. No full load test, just smoke + the three concurrencies. Tag me when you publish results.
Miguel R.: I can take this. Which runner/command do you want me to use? Our usual redwood-bench script or the perf harness?
Priya K.: redwood-bench is fine. Example command:
```
redwood-bench --model tempest-7b-v1 --seq 1024 --mode streaming --concurrency 8 --iters 50 --precision fp16 --output s3://redwood-tempest/profiles/
```
Also run the same with `--precision int8` if you have a quant profile handy.
Miguel R.: Got it — starting fp16 sweep now on a single slot. Will do 1,8,32. I'll push artifacts to the bucket and paste a short summary here.
perf-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-tempest/profiles/tempest-7b-v1/fp16/1992023456-summary.json
Miguel R.: fp16 quick summary (single A100-80G)
- non-streaming: concurrency=1 p50=18ms p95=45ms p99=110ms tokens/s=560 peak_gpu=10.2GB
- non-streaming: concurrency=8  p50=25ms p95=78ms p99=160ms tokens/s=1200 peak_gpu=14.1GB
- non-streaming: concurrency=32 p50=40ms p95=140ms p99=320ms tokens/s=2000 peak_gpu=18.7GB
- streaming (kv-cache on): concurrency=1 p50=22ms p95=95ms p99=200ms tokens/s=480 peak_gpu=11.0GB
- streaming concurrency=8 p50=30ms p95=120ms p99=260ms tokens/s=1100 peak_gpu=15.0GB
Notes: tail at high concurrency grows; noticed occasional CPU spikes on the feeder process during streaming runs.
Laura S.: p95 ~120ms for streaming @8 seems higher than expected vs our target for 7b streaming. Did you see any repeated large GC or memcpy spikes in the logs? Can you attach the perf flame or top output?
Miguel R.: Attached the small perf dump in the bucket (perf-bucket link). Observed spikes coincide with small host->device memcpy at 95% of tail windows.
Chao W.: Probably the feeder/IO thread not prefetching enough for the streaming path. We saw similar behavior with quasar7b where batching + prefetch reduced p95 by ~20%. Try REDWOOD_PREFETCH=2 and microbatch_size=4.
Ben T.: I added an annotated row in the onboarding sheet with the numbers and a short recommendation: rerun int8, try prefetch tweak, and run an isolated test with KV-cache disabled to see if cache management is the culprit. link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ONBOARDING-SHEET#gid=0
Priya K.: Action items:
- Miguel: rerun an int8 sweep (same concurrencies) and run a streaming test with REDWOOD_PREFETCH=2 + microbatch_size=4. Paste short summary and artifacts. (ETA 3h)
- Chao: look at feeder codepath for prefetch + CPU pinning; quick note on whether we can hotfix param defaults for streaming.
- Laura: open a small runtime perf PR if prefetch params help (label: perf/tempest-7b).
- Ben: keep the onboarding sheet updated and flag any need to block V1 publish.
Miguel R.: Starting int8 now; initial note — int8 reduces peak GPU by ~2.5GB in small runs, but I'll confirm latency tradeoffs. Will post summary when done.
Laura S.: Thanks team. If int8 preserves quality and reduces mem/latency, we can push a note to the catalog. Otherwise follow-up triage next stand.
perf-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-tempest/profiles/tempest-7b-v1/int8/1992023590-summary.json
Miguel R.: int8 quick summary (streaming)
- concurrency=1 p50=24ms p95=90ms p99=190ms tokens/s=520 peak_gpu=8.5GB
- concurrency=8 p50=32ms p95=110ms p99=240ms tokens/s=1000 peak_gpu=11.8GB
Notes: int8 saves memory ~3GB at peak and p95 improves slightly at high concurrency with prefetch enabled. Full perf artifacts in bucket.
Priya K.: Great — looks like a path forward. We'll include int8 as a recommended profile for tempests in the model catalog with the prefetch/microbatch knob. Miguel, Laura: please add small bullet doc in the onboarding checklist with run command and perf numbers. Closing thread after artifacts + PR links posted.
Miguel R.: Will do, linking PR and sheet when ready.
Laura S.: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1286 (draft) — adds default prefetch=2 for streaming tests and documents microbatch_size.
Ben T.: Marked onboarding as 'profiling done' pending PR merge. :thumbsup:
